Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed with a prayer to direct the court concerned to decide the S.T. No. 994 of 2016, arising out of case crime no. 591 of 2013, under Sections 328, 376, 323, 504, 506, 500 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Ghaziabad pending in the Court of Sessions Judge, Ghaziabad, expeditiously within stipulated period.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Ghaziabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is appearing for the informant in the said session trial and same is pending since 2016.
The Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said case.
The case is at the stage of recording evidence.
Evidence of fact witnesses has been recorded.
It is also submitted that now the evidence of the I.O. is to be recorded but he is not appearing despite various directions issued by the trial court.
4. Learned AGA opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6. It reveals from the perusal of the order sheets that the case is pending at the stage of evidence.
Now the evidence of the I.O. is to be recorded but he is not appearing before the trial court for the said purpose.
It is reminded that the criminal Courts are never toothless or powerless to ensure compliance of its own orders by the concerned police and administrative authorities.
They have got ample powers for the same under law itself.
The trial court is expected to invoke its power to ensure service of process upon the witnesses, which is sent under its seal and order in order to procure their presence.

7. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to invoke the powers given to it under law to ensure the presence of the witnesses particularly the I.O. of the case by sending appropriate process to him as early as possible and record his evidence within one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it, if there is no legal impediment.

8. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
